targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM detection_rule_versions
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) END as value FROM detection_replay_results
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM detection_false_positive_reports WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM detection_suppressions WHERE is_active = true
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM detection_suppressions WHERE is_active = true AND expires_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM detection_promotion_requests WHERE status = 'pending'

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) as time, SUM(CASE WHEN passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as passed, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed FROM detection_replay_results WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as fp_reports FROM detection_false_positive_reports WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT tactic, COUNT(DISTINCT technique_id) as techniques FROM detection_attack_mappings WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY tactic ORDER BY techniques DESC
SELECT reason_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM detection_false_positive_reports GROUP BY reason_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM detection_promotion_requests GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT date_trunc('day', computed_at) as time, AVG(quality_score) as avg_quality FROM detection_quality_metrics WHERE computed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT rule_id, round(quality_score::numeric, 3) as quality_score, quality_trend, fp_report_count, replay_fail_count FROM detection_quality_metrics WHERE quality_trend = 'degrading' ORDER BY quality_score ASC LIMIT 20
SELECT rule_id, scope, expires_at, approval_state FROM detection_suppressions WHERE is_active = true AND expires_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY expires_at ASC LIMIT 20
SELECT rule_id, version, stage, LEFT(rule_hash, 16) as hash_prefix, change_reason, created_at FROM detection_rule_versions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
